label: CREST syndrome (limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis)
summary: A bounded limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis map: anticentromere autoimmunity, endothelial vasculopathy with a pulmonary arterial hypertension branch, fibroblast activation and calcinosis associations. Raynaud's phenomenon has no supported edge yet. Diffuse cutaneous SSc-specific features, scleroderma renal crisis, morphea and overlap syndromes are out of scope.
query: (TITLE_ABS:"CREST syndrome" OR TITLE_ABS:"limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis" OR TITLE_ABS:"limited systemic sclerosis" OR TITLE_ABS:"anticentromere")
